def read_and_clean(csv_path):
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    df = df.dropna(subset=["campaign_id", "customer_email"])
    df["sent_at"] = pd.to_datetime(df["sent_at"])
    df["opened"] = df["opened"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    return df
